meta.name: Escandalosos
meta.description: Tres hermanos osos tratan torpemente de encontrar su lugar en una sociedad civilizada, ya sea buscando comida, tratando de hacer amigos humanos o intentando hacerse famosos en Internet.

trailers.name: We Bare Bears (Volume 1): Viral Video - Official Trailer

trailerStreams.title: We Bare Bears (Volume 1): Viral Video - Official Trailer

videos.title: Nuestras cosas
videos.overview: Luego de un juego de básquetbol, los osos descubren que les robaron la mochila con todas sus cosas.

videos.title: Video viral
videos.overview: Los osos intentan hacer un video viral como el que hizo Nom Nom, que descubren que es un arrogante koala

videos.title: Camión de comida
videos.overview: Los osos abren un camión de comida, pero sus clientes animales comienzan a espantar a los demás.

videos.title: Chloe
videos.overview: Chloe, la niña prodigio, está haciendo una presentación sobre los osos, que hacen algunos ajustes a su trabajo.

videos.title: La cita de Panda
videos.overview: Panda se enamora de Lucy, quien lo salva de una terrible reacción alérgica a las nueces en el mercado de productores.

videos.title: Osos cotidianos
videos.overview: Un día normal de los osos incluye una lucha con un ratón y con un robot de limpieza y, además, a Pardo atascado en un árbol.

videos.title: Burrito
videos.overview: A Pardo le gustan tanto los burritos que lleva consigo un burro gigante a dondequiera que va.

videos.title: Naturaleza
videos.overview: Para conservar sus habilidades de supervivencia a punto, los osos se pierden en el bosque a propósito.

videos.title: Chaqueta de mezclilla
videos.overview: Los osos se pelean por una chaqueta que les da buena suerte. Pero la magia se convierte en maldición.

videos.title: Nom Nom
videos.overview: Después de una rabieta al aire, Nom Nom pierde su fama y les suplica a los osos que lo ayuden a protagonizar una película

videos.title: Ninjas shhh
videos.overview: Luego de que un ruidoso público les arruinara una película, los osos se convierten en los ninjas shhh en la sala de cine.

videos.title: Mi manada
videos.overview: Los osos hacen una fiesta en su cueva para ayudarle a Chloe a hacerse amiga de sus compañeros de clase mayores

videos.title: Charlie
videos.overview: Charlie  se inscribe en línea para pasar un fin de semana con los osos, pero resulta ser un huésped muy molesto

videos.title: El oso de arriba
videos.overview: Panda ahuyenta un grupo de lobos y eso lo convierte en el hermano alfa, lo que perturba la jerarquía de los osos

videos.title: Osos habitantes
videos.overview: Los osos deben probar que son dueños de la cueva para evitar que un equipo de demolición la destruya.

videos.title: El estornudo de Panda
videos.overview: Nom Nom siente que su fama está amenazada gracias a un adorable video de un estornudo de Panda que se hace muy popular.

videos.title: El camino
videos.overview: Cuando eran pequeños, los osos trataron de que alguien los recogiera de una caja en la carretera, hasta que alguien se las robó

videos.title: Emergencia
videos.overview: Pardo tiene como mascota un cangrejo que pellizca la oreja de Polar y todos deben ir al hospital.

videos.title: Vida ecológica
videos.overview: Los osos se esfuerzan por la aceptación social, entonces deciden dejar de usar bolsas plásticas y ensayar las reutilizables.

videos.title: Charlie y la serpiente
videos.overview: Charlie organiza una fiesta para hacer amigos, pero termina de aventuras con una serpiente.

videos.title: Videocita
videos.overview: Polar y Pardo tratan de ayudarle a Panda a mostrar su mejor cara en una cita por video con una chica francesa.

videos.title: Tienda de mascotas
videos.overview: De pequeños, los osos trataron de encontrar un hogar apareciendo en un tierno comercial de una tienda de mascotas para adopción

videos.title: Chloe y Polar
videos.overview: Mientras Pardo y Panda juegan videojuegos, Chloe y Polar buscan algo divertido que hacer en la ciudad.

videos.title: La tienda de cupcakes
videos.overview: Los osos obtienen un trabajo en una tienda de pastelitos para pagar la reparación de una computadora.

videos.title: Hibernación
videos.overview: Pardo aprende todo sobre la hibernación y se prepara para el profundo sueño que se aproxima.

videos.title: Charlie Ball
videos.overview: After Panda gets injured on the basketball court, the Bears invite Charlie to be on their basketball team. But when Charlie gets too good, he starts to ruin all the fun of the game.

videos.title: Yard Sale
videos.overview: Each of the Bears get offbeat items at a local yard sale. Their new possessions send them on their own separate adventures.

videos.title: Slumber Party
videos.overview: A thunderstorm forces Chloe to spend the night at the Cave with the Bears. When Chloe's parents tell the Bears to protect Chloe, they take the task a bit too seriously.

videos.title: Bear Cleanse
videos.overview: A doctor tells the Bears to go on a cleanse to improve their health. But when Grizz realizes he can only eat what grizzly bears eat, he starts to lose his mind.

videos.title: Nom Nom's Entourage
videos.overview: Nom Nom recruits the Bears to act as his entourage of friends. But when the Bears realize Nom Nom doesn't understand friendship, they decide to kick their day of bonding into high gear.

videos.title: Ranger Tabes
videos.overview: To recover a missing package, the Bears get help from Ranger Tabes, an eccentric forest ranger. But her overblown sense of justice might be too much for the Bears to handle.

videos.title: Rooms
videos.overview: The Bears switch bedrooms for the night and get a glimpse of the living space of one of their brothers. But the deeper they go, hidden secrets are revealed.

videos.title: Losing Ice
videos.overview: Feeling unappreciated, Ice Bear leaves his brothers to be the chef of a restaurant. Desperate to fill the void, Grizz and Panda look for Ice Bear's replacement.

videos.title: Cellie
videos.overview: Fed up with sharing, Panda forbids his brothers from using his cellphone any longer. But when the brothers get their own super advanced smartphones, Panda starts to succumb to crippling jealousy.

videos.title: Fashion Bears
videos.overview: In order to abide by the clothing policy of their favorite Boba shop, the Bears get some new outfits. But with new looks come new lives including office work, fashion modeling and even falling in love!

videos.title: The Island
videos.overview: While trying to sail to Japan, the Baby Bears get stranded on an island. Luckily, they meet Dave and Karla, who help with survival on the island while looking for an escape.

videos.title: Bear Flu
videos.overview: The Bears become terribly ill and Chloe takes it upon herself to take care of them. But things get tricky when word of the Bears' sickness goes viral.

videos.title: Chicken and Waffles
videos.overview: Panda needs to meet his brothers at the most exclusive restaurant in town. But when he loses his contacts lenses and can't see, Panda needs Charlie's help to get him into the city.

videos.title: The Audition
videos.overview: The Bears audition to be the next mascot for their favorite cereal. They get so caught up in the process that their competitiveness gets the best of them.

videos.title: Captain Craboo
videos.overview: The Bears are reunited with their pet crab, Captain Craboo. But after an unfortunate run-in with Nom Nom, the Bears may lose their pet forever.

videos.title: Baby Bears on a Plane
videos.overview: The Baby Bears have an adventure in the sky while aboard a plane to Sweden. But when the baby Bears are forced to sit in different sections of the plan, things get a bit haywire for everyone on board.

videos.title: Yuri and the Bear
videos.overview: Baby Ice Bear lives alone in the arctic and meets a mysterious man named Yuri. Together they help each other survive the cold environment.

videos.title: Icy Nights
videos.overview: Ice Bear rides his custom vacuum into the city. But when a gang of techies steal the vacuum, Ice Bear goes on a rescue mission that takes him through the underground world of the city.

videos.title: Everyone's Tube
videos.overview: Through a standard video browsing session online, we get a glimpse of the different kinds of videos the Bears have posted.

videos.title: Creature Mysteries
videos.overview: Ranger Tabes tells the Bears she's been investigating a mysterious creature. But when the Bears realize she's actually investigating their friend Charlie, they split up to ensure Charlie's safety.

videos.title: The Library
videos.overview: The Bears find Chloe in the library exhausted from studying for an exam all day. The Bears stay to help Chloe study but make things worse in the process.

videos.title: Grizz Helps
videos.overview: When his brothers don't need his help for the day, Grizz leaves the cave to assist anyone he can throughout the city.

videos.title: Christmas Parties
videos.overview: The Bears have been invited to all their friends' Christmas parties. In an effort to have time to crash Nom Nom's huge star-studded bash, the Bears first try to make quick stops at all their friends' parties throughout the night.

videos.title: Grizzly the Movie
videos.overview: Grizz gets cast in a movie about a Grizzly Bear! But Grizz soon realizes the movie's depiction of grizzly bears is not what he had in mind.

videos.title: Subway
videos.overview: The bears become stranded on a subway platform after missing their train, but while waiting, they must recover some lost items.

videos.title: Anger Management
videos.overview: In order to appear on a successful kids show, Nom Nom must complete anger management- with Grizz as his therapist.

videos.title: Panda's Friend
videos.overview: Panda uses an app to find a friend with whom he has more in common, but things take a turn for the worse when the new friend gets too possessive.
The baby bears' dreams come true when they discover a $100 bill; but when they can't bear to spend it, they have difficulty letting go.

videos.title: Neighbors
videos.overview: New neighbors set up camp next to the cave. The bears love it at first, but when Grizz overhears them talking about their questionable previous bear encounters, he begins an investigation.

videos.title: Professor Lampwick
videos.overview: When Chloe’s professor is too mean to give her any face time to talk over her failing grade, the bears take matters into their own hands by kidnapping him. However, this professor turns out to be rather conniving and has the bears turn on each other.

videos.title: Ralph
videos.overview: Charlie meets a creature just like him named Ralph (voiced by John DiMaggio) and befriends him, but Ralph turns out to be a cruel prankster which troubles the bears.

videos.title: Planet Bears
videos.overview: In a BBC-style nature documentary, an omniscient narrator covers the bears' morning when they run out of food and must head to the grocery store.

videos.title: Coffee Cave
videos.overview: When they learn that Ice Bear is a talented barista, the bears turn the cave into a popular coffee shop. However, things go awry when in order to keep up their coffee's quality, Grizz and Panda give Ice Bear some caffeine despite his warnings.

videos.title: El pie grande de Charlie
videos.overview: Los protagonistas son tres osos hermanos: Pardo, Panda y Pola. Durante sus intentos de integración con la sociedad humana, los osos tienen dificultades para asimilar la civilizada naturaleza de los humanos. Sin embargo, pronto se dan cuenta de que tienen los unos a los otros para apoyarse.

videos.title: The Demon
videos.overview: While playing with a potato gun, Chloe and Ice Bear lose her prized hoodie to the dog, nicknamed The Demon, next door so they set out on a mission to retrieve it.

videos.title: Panda's Art
videos.overview: For his community college art project, Panda is inspired to paint a picture of Charlie. Panda gives the painting to Charlie, but when he is offered a chance to showcase his art, Panda must get the painting back.

videos.title: Poppy Rangers
videos.overview: Ranger Tabes leads a troop of young girls into a cave expedition, and brings Grizz as their cave expert. However, things get intense when Tabes and Grizz butt heads.

videos.title: Lucy's Brother
videos.overview: While Grizz and Ice Bear help Lucy with her deliveries, Panda tries to impress Lucy by taking care of her allergic younger brother, Clifford.

videos.title: The Fair
videos.overview: The baby bears become prizes for a carnival game in hopes of being won and taken to a new home, but the game owner will do anything to keep the Bears from leaving.

videos.title: Private Lake
videos.overview: When the local lake is overcrowded with tourists, the Bears have fun at Charlie’s private lake. However, trouble rises when the Bears mistakenly make its presence known on social media.

videos.title: Lunch with Tabes
videos.overview: The Bears have lunch with Ranger Tabes, but when Tabes's lunch gets stolen, Tabes goes into full on detective mode to find the culprit.

videos.title: Road Trip
videos.overview: Chloe and the Bears take a road trip to see a meteor shower. Ice Bear, the only one licensed to drive, is put in charge, which becomes harder than he thought, especially when they pick up a hitchhiker.

videos.title: Summer Love
videos.overview: Panda goes on a mission to return a lost phone to the girl of his dreams and encounters various obstacles along the way including the Mad Scientist from "Grizz Helps".

videos.title: The Kitty
videos.overview: The Bears encounter a kitten that they decide to adopt and name Thunderbolt, however they quickly discover that the kitten is actually a cougar cub and that its cougar family have made themselves at home in the cave.

videos.title: Crowbar Jones
videos.overview: Grizz screens an epic amateur movie he just made for a focus group, but when he notices people and animals are leaving he must figure out ways to keep the audience engaged.

videos.title: Kyle
videos.overview: After talking about his lost family on a talk show, Nom Nom is met with another Koala named Kyle who claims to be his brother. However, Nom Nom's bodyguard begins to have his suspicions.

videos.title: Citizen Tabes
videos.overview: After Ranger Tabes accidentally breaks a deer's antler, she quits her job and turns to an online craft service, the Bears do what they can to coax her out of retirement when they realize nature's not the same without her.

videos.title: Dance Lessons
videos.overview: Panda volunteers to be Lucy's partner for a dance contest to win a produce truck. But Panda doesn't have the heart to tell Lucy that she's a terrible dancer. His attempts to forfeit the contest soon hurt his friend’s feelings.

videos.title: Icy Nights II
videos.overview: Ice Bear gets a sinister message from Barry (from "Icy Nights") and must rescue his friend Yana. He falls into a trap and both he and Yana must escape.

videos.title: Dog Hotel
videos.overview: While their cave gets fumigated for a cockroach infestation, the Bears check into the Waggington Dog Hotel for the night. Panda and Ice Bear leave due to disliking the hotel's rules, but Grizzly wants to stay. When he gets mistaken for a rabid dog, his brothers must save him.

videos.title: Bear Lift
videos.overview: To raise money to save Darrell's store, the Bears use the stack as a taxi through a ride share app, eventually they run into Darrell's landlord and the Bears must outrun him before the landlord gets to Darrell's store and tears it down.

videos.title: The Nom Nom Show
videos.overview: During Nom Nom's new TV show, all his special guests end up unable to appear, so Nom Nom hires the Bears as the replacements, but each act gets ruined by their antics.

videos.title: Ice Cave
videos.overview: After being excluded from a board game with the Bears and Charlie because of his additude, Ralph takes over the Bear's cave overnight and turns it into a snowy fortress where he reigns as king over everybody.

videos.title: Spa Day
videos.overview: The Bears have a relaxing day at the spa. Grizz tries to get everything the spa has to offer, Panda gets trapped in the steam room with an old man, and Ice Bear plays ping pong.

videos.title: Charlie's Halloween Thing
videos.overview: Charlie tells a group of trick or treaters two scary stories for Halloween: The Bears buy three dolls that look like them that come to life and try to murder them and Grizz accidentally bites Chloe who slowly transforms into a werebear.

videos.title: Bunnies
videos.overview: While the baby bears are on their way to the Denver Chocolate Fest, they encounter a burrow of bunnies who are constantly under attack by crows. Grizz and Ice Bear want to help them, but Panda is determined to get to the festival.

videos.title: Pigeons
videos.overview: Grizz befriends a single footed pigeon named Brenda and her friends. When they ask him to help break out more of their pigeon brethren, Grizz is willing to help, only to discover that her fellow pigeons are the pigeon cartel from "Our Stuff".

videos.title: Panda 2
videos.overview: Baby Panda happily lives in a closed off environment for study. But when he's given a new friend, Panda 2, his worldview is shaken, which sets him off on a great adventure.

videos.title: Tubin
videos.overview: In search of some adventure, the Bears ride a tube down a dangerous river.

videos.title: Lazer Royale
videos.overview: The Baby Bears sign up for a game of laser tag, hoping to win some ice cream. But, the round of laser tag turns out to be less of a game and more like a war zone.

videos.title: Ranger Games
videos.overview: Ranger Tabes once again leads the Poppy Rangers in a kick ball tournament against their rivals Ranger Jao and the Ivy Rangers. Grizz comes along as a cheerleader, but when Wallace hurts her ankle he gets promoted to player.

videos.title: The Perfect Tree
videos.overview: Chloe and Ice Bear drive up north to find the perfect Christmas tree and while looking for one, they stumble upon a wild turkey while Grizz and Panda are left in charge to decorate Chloe’s house but have a lot of trouble.

videos.title: Bearz II Men
videos.overview: The Baby Bears help a teenager named Nate accomplish his dream of being a famous singer, but when he wants to enter a talent show and can only enter with the accompany of a guardian, the Baby Bears disguise themselves as Nate’s father.

videos.title: Bro Brawl
videos.overview: The Bears participate in a brother-themed game show against Panda's BFF, Tom and his roommates Griff and Isaac for a brand new luxury apartment, but when Panda hears that Tom can’t afford his current apartment anymore and that him and his roommates might split up, Panda might have to sacrifice the game.

videos.title: Hurricane Hal
videos.overview: Professor Lampwick covers how everything is connected to the Bears when a hurricane rolls in. When the Bears are in three different locations, Grizz looks after Ranger Tabes' Poppy Rangers, Panda is stuck with Charlie in his car in the forest, and Chloe and Ice Bear are in the Bay Area seeking a ride home.

videos.title: Vacation
videos.overview: Nom Nom's stress levels spike due to an unexpected resurgence in his popularity. At the suggestion of his doctor, Nom Nom decides to take a vacation at a eucalyptus spa. His doctor assigns Grizz as his "comfort pet", who must protect him from his ravid fans or else his stress levels will cause him to die.

videos.title: Beehive
videos.overview: The Bears and Ranger Tabes find a beehive. When Tabes leaves so she can remove it safely, the Bears taste the honey and become entranced. They turn their cave into a large beehive and start serving the queen bee for more honey forcing Tabes to come to their rescue in removing the hive.

videos.title: The Park
videos.overview: The Bears spend a day at the park. Grizz works out, but has his bag stolen by someone, Panda attempts to sell his artwork and gets picked up by a police officer on a horse and Ice Bear trains some kids at a playground his martial arts knowledge.

videos.title: I am Ice Bear
videos.overview: After Ice Bear hits his head, he suddenly takes on a more social, talkative and "cooler" personality which pleases Grizz and Panda, but when he begins to abandon them and become a jerk, they must find a way to turn their brother back to normal.

videos.title: Baby Bears Can't Jump
videos.overview: In order to win a pizza, the Baby Bears play basketball against a ragtag gang of kids. They end up getting help in the form of a Charles Barkley card who teaches them teamwork and in the process, the Bears learn their signature "Bearstack".

videos.title: De pesca
videos.overview: Los Osos pasan un día de pesca con un capitán exagerado y gruñón que desea atrapar a un pez naranja gigante de la bahía. Sus planes cambian repentinamente cuando el gran pez aparece y se traga al capitán y las llaves del bote. En medio del caos, Polar se llena de coraje y decide enfrentar a la bestia para obtener las llaves.

videos.title: Teacher's Pet
videos.overview: The Bears win a tour of the infamous Googs corporate headquarters.

videos.title: Googs
videos.overview: En un golpe de suerte, los osos pueden llegar a conocer la empresa más famosa del mundo. Y quizá la más siniestra. En este episodio, los Bears son afortunados y ganan una entrada para hacer un recorrido por la sede corporativa de Googs, una corporación tan gigantesca como enigmática.

videos.title: Paperboyz
videos.overview: The Baby Bears get jobs as paper boys.

videos.title: Bear Squad
videos.overview: Tabes deputizes the Bears so they can go to the city and catch a thief.

videos.title: Lil' Squid
videos.overview: The Baby Bears build a submarine and explore the depths of an aquarium so they can bring a lost squid to its family.

videos.title: I, Butler
videos.overview: The Bears use a robot bear to help around the house. But things get tricky when they lose control of the robot.

videos.title: Family Troubles
videos.overview: Baby Grizz lives on the set of a sitcom in which he stars. But when a cooler kid joins the cast, Grizz feels threatened.

videos.title: Best Bears
videos.overview: The Bears must complete their Best-Man duties on the day of Darrell's wedding.

videos.title: Crowbar Jones: Origins
videos.overview: Grizz pitches his Crowbar Jones prequel film to Nom Nom, hoping Nom Nom will agree to appear in the movie.

videos.title: Salsa Picante
videos.overview: Pardo, Pando y Polar no son más que tres forasteros en busca de adaptación... y si pueden conseguir algo de helado en el camino, ¡mucho mejor! En cada episodio se muestran las desventuras cotidianas de los osos, que buscan comida, hacen todo tipo de tonterías y lidian unos con otros y con el mundo que los rodea.

videos.title: Mom App
videos.overview: Hoping to finally get the mom-experience, the Bears use an app that'll bring a mom right to their door.

videos.title: La limosina
videos.overview: Panda está cabizbajo y se lo nota triste y preocupado por sus problemas románticos. Para levantarle el ánimo, Pardo y Polar piensan en diferentes estrategias. Hasta que se les ocurre algo muy original: regalarle un divertido y exclusivo paseo en una enorme limusina.

videos.title: More Everyone's Tube
videos.overview: Through another video browsing session online, we get more videos uploaded by the Bears and their friends.

videos.title: Money Man
videos.overview: The Bears help Chloe present her project for a college science contest, but Chloe’s rival makes things difficult.

videos.title: Rescue Ranger
videos.overview: Tabes helps the Bears rescue Charlie after a villainous game hunter captures him.

videos.title: El Oso
videos.overview: In a flashback to long ago, Charlie has an adventure in the Mexican desert.

videos.title: Escandalosos
videos.overview: The Baby Bears enter a Mexican wrestling tournament.

videos.title: Pizza Band
videos.overview: The Bears get pizza at Papa Bear's Pizza Cave and wind up replacing the place's animatronic band. They're such a hit that they go on tour!

videos.title: Adopted
videos.overview: The Baby Bears get adopted by an eccentric millionaire and get to live in his mansion.

videos.title: Wingmen
videos.overview: In order to get some sleep, the Bears help an annoying bird find a new mate.

videos.title: Braces
videos.overview: When the Bears go to the dentist, Panda gets braces. But, Panda finds out his braces grant him super abilities and the power goes to his head.

videos.title: Christmas Movies
videos.overview: On Christmas Eve, the Baby Bears defend a video store from getting robbed.

videos.title: Imaginary Friend
videos.overview: The Baby Bears invent an imaginary friend, but the trouble he causes is all too real.

videos.title: The Mall
videos.overview: The Bears go the mall and encounter their human counterparts.

videos.title: Tunnels
videos.overview: The Bears discover a network of tunnels underneath the cave. Are they prepared to discover where they lead to and who dug them?

videos.title: Ramen
videos.overview: The Baby Bears help a struggling ramen chef perfect her ramen and save her shop.

videos.title: The Gym
videos.overview: At the suggestion of a member, the Bears decide to go to Mystique Physique Gym in see if they are "gym material". Grizz takes part in rock wall climbing only to be outdone by a child, Panda takes up virtual biking that goes from calm to terrifying and Ice Bear takes a tai-chi class where he goes up against some intimidating old ladies.

videos.title: Bubble
videos.overview: After watching a horror movie called Germs, Panda becomes a severe germaphobe. To solve the problem, he purchases a bubble for him to maneuver around in. Grizz and Ice Bear become annoyed, especially when he starts acting rude towards Charlie, but when Panda gets stuck in a waste dump and unable to escape, Charlie risks everything to save him.

videos.title: Baby Orphan Ninja Bears
videos.overview: While navigating the New York City sewers, the Baby Bears encounter ninja master Cheddar (Dante Basco) who must stop the Boot Crew, lead by his former ally Slice (Greg Chun), from causing mayhem in the city. The Baby Bears decide to become his pupils and learn the ways of the ninja while also having to deal with an alligator in the sewers.

videos.title: Fire!
videos.overview: While enjoying some picnickers' cooking, a small fire accidentally is set in a bush. Grizz uses his quick thinking to put it out and is made an honorary fire marshal by the local fire department. Grizz soon becomes obsessed with putting out fires and in his manic haste ends up starting one by accident at a local fish diner.

videos.title: Ranger Norm
videos.overview: Tabes, Martinez and Kirk leave for RangerCon, leaving the Bears with Ranger Norm (Rob Huebel). Norm comes off as nice though the Bears already detest him. When they finally decide to apologize for acting coldly towards him, Norm reveals himself to be an agent for the wealthy to tear down the forest for a golf course.

videos.title: Shmorby
videos.overview: The Bears get a home assistance device from Googs, due to the events of the titular episode, in the form of Shmorby who fulfills all of their home needs. However, this ends up making the Bears incredibly lazy and they become large and fat. Shmorby becomes tiresome of having to take care of them and leaves when they end up needing him most.

videos.title: Snake Babies
videos.overview: While the Bears are playing "corn hole", a visit from Charlie results in him finding six snake eggs. When they hatch, Charlie adopts them as his own and tries to raise them as a single parent. This ends up being more difficult as the Bears think he is unfit and the baby snakes end up tiring Charlie out.

videos.title: Sandcastle
videos.overview: The Baby Bears find themselves at the beach and decide to build a luxurious sandcastle as their new home. Panda falls in love for the first time with a girl named Darla (Vivienne Rutherford) who takes an interest in their home, but soon they have to protect it from her vengeful older sisters and cousins who have come to take Darla back.

videos.title: Bros in the City
videos.overview: The Bears join the Bros on the hit reality show Bros in the City. Panda tries to win the affection of their neighbor Nina (Christine Marie Cabanos) who grows close to Tom, Griff and Grizz try to dominate as the "Alpha Bro", and Isaac and Ice Bear come across the perfect stove and try to get it into the apartment.

videos.title: Cousin Jon
videos.overview: The Bears get invited to Chloe's Park Family Reunion where they are warned about her Cousin Jon, a sinister prankster who always gets away with his jokes. After the Bears suffer a series of pranks firsthand, they decide to up the ante by getting back at Jon and giving him a taste of his own medicine.

videos.title: Lord of the Poppies
videos.overview: Grizz, Tabes and the Poppy Rangers head out to an island for their island camping badge. When they forget the lunches, Tabes leaves Grizz in charge while she heads back to the mainland to get food. Grizz, in his usual careless self, misleads the rangers to the point that they become insane savages from hunger and attempt to devour Grizz.

videos.title: The Mummy's Curse
videos.overview: As the Baby Bears are walking down a road in the middle of nowhere, a mummy falls out of the back of a truck. The amulet it has says that they will be cursed if they do not return it by midnight, so the Baby Bears must get to the museum as fast as they can. However, a couple of shady figures in hats and coats start following them.

videos.title: Band of Outsiders
videos.overview: Following "Yuri and the Bear", Baby Ice Bear finds himself in the lower parts of London, struggling to get food and mourning over the loss of Yuri. He eventually encounters a trio of rebel rousers named Badger, Jo, and Ashley, who like to cause trouble. He joins their gang due to his ability with his axe, but soon things begin to take a turn for the worse.

videos.title: Tabes & Charlie
videos.overview: When Kirk goes missing, Tabes leaves the Bears at the ranger station and runs into Charlie. She convinces him to aid in finding her canine friend, but she has to wear a chicken costume to blend in as they enter the "shadier" parts of the woods for information. Meanwhile, the Bears are having trouble helping a couple of hikers when the printer starts going haywire.

videos.title: Panda's Birthday
videos.overview: To make Panda's birthday better, Grizzly and Ice Bear take him to the hotel where K-Pop group Monsta X is staying. In their usual antics, Grizzly disguised himself as a bellhop, runs afoul of another bellhop who is hungry for tips, Panda finds himself hanging onto dear life outside the hotel and Ice Bear tries to protect the group from crazy fans.

videos.title: We Bare Bears - Pilot
videos.overview: The Pilot, which was plainly titled "We Bare Bears", is the first produced episode of We Bare Bears. This pilot is separate from the main series and isn't considered the first episode.

videos.title: Bear Cleaning
videos.overview: Ice Bear vacuums the cave and accidentally rips out a patch of Grizz's fur. He tries to fix Grizz's bald spot before he notices.

videos.title: Nom Nom vs. Hamster
videos.overview: Behind the scenes with popular viral video star Nom Nom - this time, he's trying to work with an uncooperative hamster co-star.

videos.title: Panda's Dream
videos.overview: Panda gets cut in line while waiting to buy a video game and fantasizes about ways of heroically standing up for himself.

videos.title: Log Ride
videos.overview: The Bears become obsessed with taking the perfect "action shot" picture on a log ride at an amusement park.  They go on the ride over and over again until they've got the best shot.

videos.title: Goodnight Ice Bear
videos.overview: Ice Bear tries to fall asleep but the door to his fridge won't close. He tries to come up with a fix for it in any manner possible, no matter how elaborate.

videos.title: Potty Time
videos.overview: The Baby Bears search for people to adopt them is disrupted by Panda's need to find a bathroom.

videos.title: Panda's Profile Pic
videos.overview: Panda frets over not having a good photo of himself to send to a girl online. Luckily, his brothers offer their photo editing skills to help.

videos.title: Grizz: Ultimate Hero Champion
videos.overview: Grizz records his audition tape for his favorite athletic game show.

videos.title: Dreamium
videos.overview: Panda uses a relaxation app to help him get to sleep. But the the app's different sounds do more harm than good!

videos.title: Charlie's Opus
videos.overview: Charlie plays some abandoned instruments in the woods. But when other animals seem interested in the music, Charlie switches from player to conductor.

videos.title: Bear Stack
videos.overview: The Bears travel to the video game store to buy the last copy of a coveted new game. They encounter video game-like obstacles along the way.

videos.title: Frozen Ice
videos.overview: Grizz and Panda find Ice Bear frozen in a block of ice and attempt to save him.

videos.title: Assembly Required
videos.overview: The Bears have trouble assembling some recently purchased furniture.

videos.title: Cooking with Ice Bear
videos.overview: Ice Bear has a Korean-style cooking show and teaches the audience how to cook authentic Korean dishes.

videos.title: The Cave
videos.overview: The Bears try to get rid of a bat in their cave.
